name: DCLA Programs Funding
description:
This dataset records funding awards made to organizations for recreation-related programs. Each row represents one funded application and includes three fields: the application identifier (for example, FY12-AN-009139), the name of the organization receiving the award, and the total final award amount in dollars. The sample contains 5,000 rows spanning 1,234 distinct organizations, with award amounts ranging from about $2,955 to $885,870 and a median in the low tens of thousands of dollars.

The data can be used to examine how grant money is distributed across organizations and programs, compare typical award sizes, and identify the largest recipients. It supports budget transparency, grant-program evaluation, and analyses of funding concentration or equity across the organizations served. Because each row is a single application, users can also count awards per organization or explore the relationship between application volume and total funding received.
